releases.name: computer-use 0.0.6
releases.body: Window scope: every tool accepts window: '<title substring>' - screenshot crops to that window and never steals focus, the five mutating tools focus it, act, and restore the previous foreground window. Also: tool descriptions now lead with their contract, because the Code Mode catalog only shows the first ~120 characters.

## [1.9.5] - 2026-10-31

### Added

- **`window:` —— 一次调用只关于一个窗口，不是整个桌面。** 七个计算机使用工具都接受
  `window: "<标题子串>"`，只在 `call_tool` 一处实现：`screenshot` 裁剪到该窗口且**不改焦点**，
  五个变更类工具先聚焦、执行、再把用户原来的前台窗口还原。零匹配不是崩溃
  （`window-not-found` 点名子串并让你先截图看 `active_window`）；多个匹配取面积最大者。
  钉了 6 条测试，其中两条是"工具本体永远看不到这个 key"和"截图不许抢焦点"。
- **工具描述改成第一句就是契约。** 宿主在 Code Mode 目录里只显示描述的第一行（约 120 字符），
  我们原来把 `expect_title 必填` / `include_image 默认 false` / `no-observable-change 不是失败`
  都写在第二句以后——模型一个字都没看到，这才是每个 agent 都得先摸索一遍的原因。现在 7 个
  工具的首行窗口里装的就是用法，`initialize.instructions` 收成一张速查卡。

### Changed

- **新增第七个角色 `ComputerUser`，桌面控制收紧成 `Team` + 它。** 模板常驻生成（`mode: subagent`，选择器里仍然只有 Team），
  Lead 的提示词写明：**只有真的存在 computer-use MCP（我们的或任何等价的）时才派它**，没有就直说缺这个能力。
  `researcher` / `tester` 从允许列表里移除——让一个读不可信网页的角色同时握着鼠标，是本产品能凑出的最坏组合；
  被拒角色走三条已有的拦截层，且每次拦截都计数。
- **computer-use 的文档从安装手册里分出去。** 新增 `docs/computer-use.md`，承载升级规程
  （**两次重启**：摘条目 → 重启 → 装 → 写回 → 重启，因为 Windows 不让替换运行中的 exe；
  或退出 OpenCode 再装一次）、边界、审计格式与排错。`docs/installation-v2.md` 只保留
  "问一次 + 指针"，并明写**装插件时不要顺手去读那一页**——没选择加入这个功能的用户，
  不该在例行安装里读到桌面控制的操作规程。

releases.name: computer-use 0.0.4
releases.body: Documentation and prompt-level change only: the screenshot description and the server instructions now tell a vision-capable model to prefer include_image=true for the observation step, and to use the sha1/changed_pixels_pct when it only needs to know whether the screen moved. Upgrade note: quit OpenCode before installing, because the running server holds its exe open. Wheel sha256 b8c9a17093fd163552bc4f595e4ae58d4b8a1a4f1b1c2adf3f2e3a82465ca403

## [1.9.4] - 2026-10-30

### Added

- **Bounded divergence in the Lead's Step 0.** When the ask has more than one plausible
  reading and none is blocking, the Lead now names up to three readings with a one-line
  consequence each, picks one and records the discarded ones — then never re-opens the
  choice once the plan is approved. Deliberately **not** a brainstorm: quantity is not a
  goal and rounds are the unit of cost.
- **The Architect lists two or three candidate designs** (or says why only one exists)
  with a one-line trade-off each, before the recommended one. Convergence is one-way.
- **Child session ids are printed whole.** A bare full `ses_…` in a reply is rendered by
  the desktop as a chip carrying that session's title, which is the only way the user can
  open the child being described; an abbreviated id is a dead reference and a fenced one
  stays literal.

### Fixed

- **The installer keeps the wheel's filename when downloading it.** `uv tool install`
  derives the distribution name, version and Python tag from the FILENAME, so the
  guid-named temp file failed with "Must have a Python tag" even though the sha256
  verified. The download now keeps the asset's own name.
- **The installer names the locked-exe cause instead of retrying a rename.** Upgrading
  while the host runs the MCP server fails with `os error 5/32`, and renaming the running
  image is not reliable either (measured: sharing violation). It now prints the exact next
  move — quit OpenCode, re-run, reopen — while still writing zero config bytes.
- **`computeruse` 0.0.3**: the server reported `0.1.0` from a hardcoded string while the
  wheel was 0.0.2 (it now reads `importlib.metadata`), and its panic hotkey never armed
  because `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F12` was already registered (`err=1409`) — it now tries a short
  ladder and reports the combination that actually armed.

releases.name: computer-use 0.0.3
releases.body: Fixes two defects found by running the installed 0.0.2: the server reported version 0.1.0 (a hardcoded string that never followed pyproject.toml - it now reads the wheel metadata), and the panic hotkey never armed because Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F12 was already taken (RegisterHotKey err=1409) - it now tries a short ladder and reports the combination that actually armed. Wheel sha256 976ff36581111bff9c1be5058e713bbc853f08ee3eef07ce02c7909848d448f3
